IFNULL(T1.TRADE_AMT,T1.FPRICE_AMT) TRADE_AMT, T1.FEE_AMT_UNPAY, T1.FEE_AMT, T1.PS, T1.YIELD, T1.EXER_YIELD, T1.INV_AIM, T1.TRADE_STATUS, T1.IS_CANCEL, T1.P_TRADE_ID, T1.IS_CLEAN, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, T1.B_TRADE_ID, T1.COUNTER_ID, T1.IS_OUT_TRADE, T1.TRADE_MARKET, T1.TRADE_PLAT, T1.TRADE_MARKET_MODE, T1.TRADER, T1.COUNTER_TRADER, T1.COUNTER_CONTACT, T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, T1.F_TRADE_ID, T1.CASH_ID, T1.REMARK,
T1.CHL_ID,
T2.PORTFOLIO_ID, rank() over(partition BY T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID,T2.PORTFOLIO_ID ORDER BY T1.TRADE_ID) rank
FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 on T2.TRADE_ID = T1.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T3 ON T3.B_TRADE_ID = T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T5 ON T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T5.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_STL_PAY_ORDERS T41 ON T5.TRADE_ID = T41.TRADE_ID
FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 on T2.TRADE_ID = T1.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T3 ON T3.B_TRADE_ID = T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T5 ON T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T5.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN STL_PAY_ORDERS T41 ON T5.TRADE_ID = T41.TRADE_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT TC ON TC.FINPROD_ID = T1.CHL_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID
WHERE T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode}
and pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID =#{portfolioId}
and IFNULL(pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID,'null') ='null'
) temp
where temp.rank = 1
